name: _shared
title: Kit icons
description: One fixed semantic icon-symbol map for all kit blocks and bundled primitives. Real Phosphor defaults; hosts may replace this shared module or use existing icon props, independently of theme tokens.

files.content:
'use client';

// Fixed semantic symbols for registry blocks and bundled shadcn primitives. Hosts may swap this module
// or use existing icon props; theme tokens and DESIGN.md alone do not select an icon library.
import { createElement, forwardRef } from 'react';
import { CircleIcon as PhosphorCircle } from '@phosphor-icons/react';
import type { IconProps } from '@phosphor-icons/react';

export {
  WarningCircleIcon as AlertCircleIcon,
  ArchiveIcon,
  TrayArrowUpIcon as ArchiveRestoreIcon,
  ArrowDownIcon,
  ArrowLeftIcon,
  ArrowUpIcon,
  ArrowUpRightIcon,
  BellIcon,
  CubeIcon as BoxIcon,
  BrainIcon,
  CameraIcon,
  CheckIcon,
  CaretDownIcon as ChevronDownIcon,
  CaretLeftIcon as ChevronLeftIcon,
  CaretRightIcon as ChevronRightIcon,
  CaretUpIcon as ChevronUpIcon,
  CaretDoubleLeftIcon as ChevronsLeftIcon,
  CaretDoubleRightIcon as ChevronsRightIcon,

  WarningCircleIcon as CircleAlertIcon,

  TextTIcon as TypeIcon,
  ArrowUUpLeftIcon as Undo2Icon,
  UserIcon,

  FlowArrowIcon as WorkflowIcon,
  WrenchIcon,
  XIcon,
  MagnifyingGlassPlusIcon as ZoomInIcon,
  MagnifyingGlassMinusIcon as ZoomOutIcon,
  ArrowDownIcon as ArrowDown,
  ArrowUpIcon as ArrowUp,
  CaretRightIcon as ChevronRight,
  TrayIcon as Inbox,
  MinusIcon as Minus,
  SquareSplitVerticalIcon as PanelBottom,
  SquareSplitHorizontalIcon as PanelRight,
  SparkleIcon as Sparkles,
} from '@phosphor-icons/react';

// Every kit CircleIcon is a filled status/recording dot. Phosphor's regular circle is a
// path outline, so SVG fill/strokeWidth (used by existing callers) cannot fill its centre.
// Keep the native SVG props and ref, while allowing an explicit native weight override.
export const CircleIcon = forwardRef<SVGSVGElement, IconProps>((props, ref) =>
  createElement(PhosphorCircle, { weight: 'fill', ...props, ref }));
